interpretationLimits: The A300 90 mm and P000 130 mm cup spacings cannot make both centers coincident by rigid translation.
The accepted Demo policy aligns the two-cup cluster midpoint and requires each native target point to remain inside its corresponding P000 opening with 5 mm radial margin.
Native and historical transforms calibrate the target station and current datum recipe only; they are not CAD execution poses.
Fresh non-prototype CAD, active mates, save/reopen and current cup projection postcheck remain required before registration.
Nozzle reach, real dispensing, physical fastening, collision and B-rep remain unverified.
